description: Street moods (plan 2026-11-16, ADR-044): what overgrow and signs add on top of a map's real geometry, by the state of its streets. A map names one with map.json "street_mood"; absent is the default, which changes nothing. Factors multiply the year profile's; a category factor multiplies its placement rule caps.

abandoned.note: An abandoned or fought-over city, as overgrow always drew it: vines, wild trees and car wrecks by the year profile, props in any condition.

emptied.note: A town emptied days ago: nothing has grown and few cars were left behind; props intact or worn, fewer barriers and less rubbish, no soot or bullet holes on the walls unless the map asks for damage.

lived.note: A street in daily use: no growth, no wrecks, only intact props; street furniture and plants go up, barriers, rubbish, parked vehicles and site structures go down; the walls keep posters, adverts and light wear.
